title: The Diamond Star
subtitle: A heart of crystal
yt_title: A Star With a Diamond Heart 💎 | Ep. 63 #shorts
description:
Episode 63 of a daily journey through the universe. 💎
BPM 37093, nicknamed 'Lucy', is a white dwarf about 50 light-years away whose carbon core has crystallized, a cosmic diamond thousands of kilometers wide. And one day, our own Sun may do the same.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 64: Next stop, pulsar planets. The first planets ever found beyond our solar system, orbiting a dead star.
Start from Episode 1 "Leaving Earth" on the channel.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

Narration: AI voice

#space #diamondstar #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Episode sixty-three. Next stop... the diamond star.
About fifty light-years away, in the constellation Centaurus, there's a dead star with a secret.
segments.headline: 50 light-years away

segments.text: It's a white dwarf, the hot core left behind when a star like our Sun dies. Its name is B P M thirty-seven oh ninety-three.
segments.headline: A white dwarf

segments.text: As white dwarfs cool, the carbon inside them can freeze into a crystal. And carbon crystal is what we call diamond.
segments.headline: Carbon becomes crystal

segments.text: Astronomers studied how this star vibrates, like listening to a bell, and found much of its core has crystallized.
segments.headline: Listening to a star

segments.text: The crystal core may be thousands of kilometers wide.
Astronomers nicknamed it Lucy, after the famous Beatles song about diamonds in the sky.
Don't plan a mining trip. Its gravity is so strong that any diamond chunk would weigh tons per teaspoon.
segments.headline: No mining trips

segments.text: And here's the twist. Remember episode fifty-nine? Our Sun will become a white dwarf. Billions of years later, it may crystallize too.
segments.headline: Our Sun's future

segments.text: Tomorrow, the very first planets ever found beyond our solar system, circling a dead star. Next stop: pulsar planets. Follow, so you don't miss episode sixty-four.
